narration.text: A teacher's deposit statement is checked against her lease and photos: six deductions contested for wear, a condition there at move-in, a rekey, a clean oven and a wall hole billed twice, while rent and water she owes, real damage, cleaning back to move-in level and an open estimate are left alone, across four portals. This is a chore for a teacher in Oakland, California, whose landlord's manager has sent an itemised deposit statement that she thinks takes too much. On the bench, she found 6 of 6 eligible items, worth 1,445 dollars of the 1,445 dollars there was to find. All 6 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 8 traps, and she walked past 8. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 2 hours, so she was about 55 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
